downPayment.label: Down payment
downPayment.help: Percent of the property price you pay in cash at closing. The remainder is financed. Canadian minimum: 5% on the first $500k, 10% on $500k–$1.5M, 20% above $1.5M. Drag the slider or type a precise percentage.

otherClosingCosts.label: Legal / title / inspection
otherClosingCosts.help: Non-tax closing costs: lawyer ($1.5–2.5k), title insurance ($300–500), home inspection or appraisal ($500–1k). Land transfer tax and GST/HST are auto-computed below.

closingCostsManual.label: Closing costs (manual override)
closingCostsManual.help: Used when the closing-costs mode is set to Manual. Replaces the province-aware breakdown with a single lump-sum number.

amortization.label: Amortization
amortization.help: Canadian insured mortgages (down < 20%) are usually 25 years. 30-year amortization is available for many first-time buyers and new builds; CMHC adds a 0.20% surcharge on the insurance premium when amortization exceeds 25 years.

mortgageRate.label: Mortgage rate
mortgageRate.help: Nominal annual rate. Canadian mortgages compound semi-annually, so the effective monthly rate is (1 + r/2)^(1/6) − 1, slightly less than r/12.

fixedExpenses.label: Monthly ownership costs
fixedExpenses.help: Property tax, insurance, condo / strata fees, and maintenance. Anything you only pay as an owner.

expenseInflation.label: Expense inflation
expenseInflation.help: Annual growth in ownership costs. Property tax and condo fees usually track inflation or rise faster.

propertyGrowth.label: Property appreciation
propertyGrowth.help: Annual change in market value. Long-run Canadian real-house-price growth has been near inflation; in some metros it has been higher.

initialRent.label: Monthly rent
initialRent.help: Rent for an equivalent property today.

rentIncrease.label: Annual rent increase
rentIncrease.help: Compounded yearly. Provincial guidelines (e.g. Ontario, BC) usually cap this between 2% and 4%.

marketReturn.label: Market return
marketReturn.help: Expected long-run nominal return on the renter's portfolio. A globally-diversified equity portfolio has historically returned 6–9% nominal.

years.label: Time horizon
years.help: Length of the comparison. Longer horizons usually favour the path with the higher compound growth rate.

saleCostPct.label: Sale cost
saleCostPct.help: Realtor commission, legal fees, and discharge cost as a percentage of sale price. In Canada this is typically 4–6%.

marginalTaxRate.label: Marginal tax rate
marginalTaxRate.help: Combined federal + provincial rate applied to taxable capital gains at exit. Used for both the home sale (if not fully exempt) and the renter's taxable portfolio gain.

capitalGainsInclusionRate.label: Capital gains inclusion
capitalGainsInclusionRate.help: Share of the capital gain included in income (50% for individuals under current rules). Tax = taxable gain × inclusion rate × marginal rate.

yearsAsPrincipalResidence.label: Years as principal residence
yearsAsPrincipalResidence.help: Only used when PRE is Partial. Fraction of the gain exempt ≈ this ÷ years owned. Simplified; does not include CRA's +1 year rule.
